The amount budgeted for the specified category and event [format: integer] Value: the unit is dollar 
commonsense evidence:
some computation like: amount = spent + remaining
A unique identifier for the budget entry [format: text] [primary key]
The area for which the amount is budgeted, such as, advertisement, food, parking [format: text]

the status of the event [format: text] Value: Closed / Open/ Planning 
commonsense evidence: 
• Closed: It means that the event is closed. The spent and the remaining won't change anymore.
• Open: It means that the event is already opened. The spent and the remaining will change with new expenses.
• Planning: The event is not started yet but is planning. The spent and the remaining won't change at this stage.
The unique identifier of the event to which the budget line applies. [format: text] Value: References the Event table [foreign key -> event.event_id]

A value calculated as the amount budgeted minus the amount spent [format: real] Value: the unit is dollar 
commonsense evidence: If the remaining < 0, it means that the cost has exceeded the budget.
